brand_identity.name: Dynopay (Tatum.io-Inspired Light Redesign)
brand_identity.archetype: The Performance Pro & High-Contrast Swiss Tech
brand_identity.background_philosophy: Clean pure white (#FFFFFF), ultra-airy whitespace, light slate surfaces (#F8FAFC), zero purple/indigo washes
brand_identity.safedeal_exemption: SafeDeal remains gold/black; this Tatum mint/teal-green reskin is strictly for the Dynopay marketing homepage landing page

typography.font_family_mono: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

scale.hero_h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-[#0A0F1D]
scale.section_h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#0A0F1D]
scale.caption: text-xs sm:text-sm font-medium text-[#64748B]

bento_grid.base: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8

secondary_cta.shape: rounded-[3px] px-6 py-3 text-base transition-all duration-200

homepage_section_structure.name: Announcement Bar & Sticky Header
homepage_section_structure.description: Thin mint-green gradient promo bar above white sticky header with backdrop blur, logo left, centered nav items (Products, Solutions, Developers, Resources, Pricing), right side search/locale/theme + Login + solid mint 'Start free' CTA button.

homepage_section_structure.name: Centered Hero + Sandbox Checkout + Live Settlement Strip + Trust Badges
homepage_section_structure.description: Big centered Poppins headline with mint gradient accent, two primary CTAs ('Start now →', 'Try live checkout'), live interactive coin checkout card with real prices and instant coin selection, live settlement feed ticker, and trust badges row.

homepage_section_structure.name: Partner & Customer Logo Wall
homepage_section_structure.description: Clean white background row featuring monochrome and mint-accented partner logos, showing ecosystem integration and volume trust.

homepage_section_structure.name: 'One Platform - All the Tools' Products Bento Grid
homepage_section_structure.description: 7 product surfaces rendered as sleek vignette cards (Payment Links, Hosted Checkout, Storefront, Donations, API, Subscriptions, Escrow).

homepage_section_structure.name: Interactive Code & RPC Demo Panel + Conversion Story
homepage_section_structure.description: Dark code editor panel with language tabs (cURL, Node.js, Python, Go) showing real payment link API creation alongside the 3-step conversion flow (BTC -> USDC -> Wallet).

homepage_section_structure.name: Supported Blockchains & Coins Grid
homepage_section_structure.description: Interactive grid displaying 15 supported cryptocurrencies across 9 chains with real-time network confirmation ETAs and settlement speed metrics.

homepage_section_structure.name: Dashboard Showcase & Live Stats Band
homepage_section_structure.description: High-fidelity light-themed dashboard preview showcasing real-time merchant analytics, revenue charts, and a 4-metric stats band.

homepage_section_structure.name: Proof, Security Controls & Pricing Teaser
homepage_section_structure.description: On-chain settlements verifier, grid of 9 security controls (non-custodial, key isolation, 2FA, rate limits, webhooks), and volume tier pricing fee calculator.

homepage_section_structure.name: Resources & Published Insights Carousel
homepage_section_structure.description: Carousel of published blog posts, developer guides, and integration docs with mint category tags.

homepage_section_structure.name: Contact / Get-in-Touch + FAQ Accordion + Final CTA
homepage_section_structure.description: Accordion FAQ with structured JSON-LD schema, contact support trigger, and final dual-card CTA ('See pricing' / 'Start building').

homepage_section_structure.name: Footer
homepage_section_structure.description: Comprehensive footer with high-contrast type, language picker, legal links, status indicator, and social links.

preserved_functionalities: Sticky top landing nav + mobile drawer + sticky mobile CTA
Hero live sandbox checkout widget with real crypto prices and QR code generation
Live settlement feed ticker with real-time on-chain confirmation updates
Products bento (7 product surfaces as vignette cards)
Conversion story animation (Buyer pays crypto -> Auto-convert to USDC -> Straight to wallet)
Numbers band with 4 live metrics + settlement distribution by chain
Global reach section with interactive map and supported chains grid
Developers live request/response code snippet box with cURL / JS / Python / Go tabs
Pricing tier ladder and interactive volume fee calculator
Published blog posts carousel and FAQ accordion with JSON-LD schema
instructions_to_main_agent: Apply this Tatum.io-inspired light theme exclusively to the Dynopay marketing homepage landing page.
Do NOT touch SafeDeal styling - SafeDeal must retain its gold/black visual identity.
Ensure all purple/indigo aurora washes are completely replaced with crisp mint-green accents and light slate background surfaces.
Preserve all existing dynamic components, SWR hooks, and interactive payment sandbox handlers in /app/Components/Page/Home/v6/*.
